# Foundational Phonics Small-Group Tracker

Subject: ELA
Grade band: K-2
Resource type: Progress Tracker
NYS framework label: NYS Next Generation ELA Learning Standards

## Short Description
A simple tracker for recording phonics patterns, quick checks, and next steps during small-group reading.

## Alignment Note
Connects decoding, phonological awareness, and word recognition evidence to planning notes.

## Classroom Use Case
Use during weekly small groups to spot who needs reteaching, blending practice, or extension words.

## Preview Content
- Target pattern: short a CVC words
- Evidence: read 8 of 10 words independently
- Next step: contrast short a and short i word sorts

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
